title: Mumbai
author: Gargi Saha
text:
Mumbai is the city of high rise buildings
The city of competition
The city of materialism
The city of night life
The city of enjoyment
Patience awaits impatience
To realise soaring ambitions
Touching the sky
But all things that rise
Are certain to descend
I have visited Mumbai
And you?
stanzas: Mumbai is the city of high rise buildings
